high_level_description: This image captures a close-up view of a tree branch with large, heart-shaped leaves against a clear blue sky. The leaves are predominantly green with some showing signs of light filtering through, creating a soft, almost ethereal glow on their surfaces. In the background, there are hints of red flowers, possibly bougainvillea, adding a vibrant splash of color to the scene. The perspective is from below, looking up at the branch, which gives a sense of scale and emphasizes the height of the tree.
